items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: So he was in the group and I think Herbie was doing one thing and I think Tony Williams was playing it

ctx.x: No not Paul, it was after Paul, and I guess it will come back to me. But he’s really great. So he was in the group and I think Herbie was doing one thing and I think Tony Williams was playing it — you know Tony what is 18, 19, 20? He’s doing something else. So he asked Miles, “What am I supposed to do?” Miles said, “You just, you have to be, if they play fast you play slow.” I mean you have to really adjust.

I was thinking the other day about in the 80s they had this term in jazz, the “young lions.” We had a lot of young guys coming up, and they were making albums as leaders when they were in their early 20s. You were like 33 I think when you became a leader.
